name: libisoburn-1.5.8.pl02
title: libisoburn-1.5.8.pl02
summary: libisoburn is a frontend for the libburn and libisofs libraries, which enables creation and expansion of ISO-9660 filesystems on all CD/DVD/BD media supported by libburn . This includes media like DVD+RW, which do not support multi-session management on the media level, and even plain disk files or block devices.
